items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: my cousin Harold and Lettego and a banjo player named Birdie and a base player named Fletcher, they all used to play all the house parties around there.

ctx.x: Panama, you talked about drumming and when you started drumming -- were there any drummers that you heard that inspired you to want to be a drummer? I know in my case, I used to hear Duke's band come through and admired Braud Hat Brow and I thought he was a marvelous base player and I wanted to be like him. But was there anybody, any drummers that you looked up to?

Well, there was a guy in Miami, his last name was Abrista, but one night a couple of guys got in a fight, and he was from the Bahamas and he was telling the guys to let him go, but instead of saying let him go, he said, "lette go", and he got this nickname, "Lettego", and everybody used to call him Lettego and so he and my cousin Harold who was a trumpet player, and he used to play all the house parties around Miami.

And my father was a bootlegger, and like every one once a month, he would have a party at the house so he could sell his liquor, and my cousin Harold and Lettego and a banjo player named Birdie and a base player named Fletcher, they all used to play all the house parties around there.
